text: DHL Group (Deutsche Post AG) is a listed German logistics company, but it is not purely private: KfW Bankengruppe, the state-owned German development bank, holds approximately 204 million shares, 17.727% of the share capital as at 30 June 2026. A partial state stake earns the mid tier rather than serious. Human-rights relevance is logistics labour and subcontracting across a global network.
